result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` suite passes: 4 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors. I did not commit.

**Changes**

- `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (around line 6514): the subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the other per-rep counts use. The Javadoc says cancelled purchase orders are not counted.
- `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`: added a `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` test that reproduces your example (Anna 2, Bob 1). I also added an overload of the `purchaseOrder` test helper that takes a status.

**Not changed:** `findPurchaseOrderCountPerCountry` (also in `DataStore.java`) counts purchase orders with no status filter, so cancelled ones are included there too. You didn't ask about that report, so I left it alone. I also didn't check the quarterly or latest-purchase-order reports, which you said already exclude cancelled orders.
